title: Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration in Unstructured Environments with Grounded Generative Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2510.26915v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While heterogeneous teams have typically been designed for well-specified missions with known semantics, generative intelligence, i.e., large language models (LLMs) and vision language models (VLMs), opens the possibility of teams that infer mission-relevant semantics and subtasks given high-level natural language specifications and environmental context. However, current LLM- and VLM-enabled teaming methods typically assume well-structured and known environments, limiting performance in complex real-world settings. We address these limitations via SPINE-HT, a framework that grounds the reasoning abilities of LLMs in the evolving context of a heterogeneous robot team through a three-stage process. Given mission specifications and team capabilities in natural language, an LLM infers necessary subtasks. These subtasks are validated for feasibility and then assigned to robots based on capabilities such as traversability or percept

translated_title: 基于接地生成式智能的异构机器人在非结构化环境中的协作
translated_abstract: 虽然异构团队通常是为具有已知语义、定义明确的任务而设计的，但生成式智能，即大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM），为团队能够根据高层自然语言规范和环境语境推断出与任务相关的语义和子任务开辟了可能性。然而，当前基于LLM和VLM的团队协作方法通常假设环境是结构良好且已知的，这限制了其在复杂真实环境中的性能。我们通过SPINE-HT来解决这些局限性，这是一个通过三阶段过程将LLM的推理能力接地到异构机器人团队不断演变的语境中的框架。给定以自然语言表示的任务规范和团队能力，LLM推断出必要的子任务。这些子任务经过可行性验证，然后根据可通行性或感知等能力分配给机器人……
tldr: 提出了SPINE-HT框架，通过三阶段过程将大语言模型的推理能力接地到异构机器人团队的动态语境中，使机器人团队能够在非结构化的真实环境中根据自然语言任务规范推断、验证并分配子任务。
en_tdlr: SPINE-HT is a three-stage framework that grounds LLM reasoning in the evolving context of heterogeneous robot teams, enabling them to infer, validate, and assign subtasks from natural language mission specifications in unstructured real-world environments.
